summary: Whether you show it or not, a need to be seen and to matter and deep feelings and a strong need to feel safe are fused in you — you can't run one without the other. At your best, you shine and lead without trying and you read people and care on instinct. At the edge, you make it all about you, or you shrink when no one's looking.
body: Whether you show it or not, a need to be seen and to matter and deep feelings and a strong need to feel safe are fused in you — you can't run one without the other. At your best, you shine and lead without trying and you read people and care on instinct. At the edge, you make it all about you, or you shrink when no one's looking. Self-direction reads as either steady and integrated, or as internal conflict that undercuts decisiveness. Identity and emotional need can sit close together here. What you want and what you feel may be difficult to separate.
gift: At your best: you shine and lead without trying, and you read people and care on instinct.
shadow: The trap: you make it all about you, or you shrink when no one's looking — or your moods run you, or you bury what you actually need.
integration: Let identity and emotional needs cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Self-direction reads as either steady and integrated, or as internal conflict that undercuts decisiveness.

Let you shine and you read people work together
